title: New account starts with safe defaults
why: Verifies that a new account is not trusted by default: unconfirmed email, lockout enabled, no failed logins.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with a valid passenger (Email ben.okafor@example.com, UserName ben.okafor, PassPortNumber NG4455667, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword), then read the saved User.

expect: Registration succeeds. The saved User has EmailConfirmed false, LockoutEnabled true, AccessFailedCount 0, TwoFactorEnabled false, and LockoutEnd empty.
